facility.name: Listed family home #1679618
facility.programs_provided: After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Part Time Care

provenance.note: Home-based program: street address, phone and provider name are not shown.

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: AP Additional Caregiver Responsibilities - Number of Unrelated Children Never Exceeds 3: Based on the evidence obtained during the DFPS investigation, the primary caregiver was caring for 6 unrelated children. The maximum number of unrelated children in care can be 3 at all times.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Additional Caregiver Responsibilities - Number of Unrelated Children Never Exceeds 3 (26 TAC §742.307(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Initiating Background Checks as Specified in 26 TAC, Chapter 745, Subchapter F: Based on the evidence obtained during the DFPS investigation, there is sufficient evidence to support that both the primary caregiver and the substitute caregiver and household member do not have a current background check. The substitute caregiver moved into the home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Initiating Background Checks as Specified in 26 TAC, Chapter 745, Subchapter F (26 TAC §742.307(1))

occurrences.finding: Additional Caregiver Responsibilities - Obtain From Parents Child's Name and Birthdate: Based on the evidence obtained during the DFPS investigation, The primary caregiver did not have records which showed she obtained the admission information from parents before admitting the children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Additional Caregiver Responsibilities - Obtain From Parents Child's Name and Birthdate (26 TAC §742.307(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on the evidence obtained during the DFPS investigation, the primary caregiver used poor judgement when the children in care were left under the supervision of someone who did not meet substitute caregiver qualifications. Additionally, substitute caregiver was unable to intervene physically or verbally prior to a child running away from the home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §742.303(2))
